original: Press to add 1 copy to inventory.
translation: 按键添加 1 个到背包。

original: Nothing in this category matches your search.
translation: 此分类中没有匹配搜索的物品。

original: Browse all 50+ Bounty Notices and Wanted Posters (Simon, Ulzok, Haldin, etc.).
translation: 浏览50多份悬赏通告和通缉令（西蒙等）。

original: Browse Skull Collector's Journal, archive records, voyager logs & historical notes.
translation: 浏览骷髅收集者日志、档案记录、航海日志和历史笔记。

original: Browse cooking recipe books, armor/weapon blueprints, and skill manuals.
translation: 浏览烹饪配方、武器防具蓝图和技能手册。

original: Browse quest dungeon keys, gate keys, vault keys, and quest memories.
translation: 浏览任务地牢钥匙、大门钥匙、宝库钥匙和任务记忆

original: Browse Collectibles Chest, private storage items, and ceramic relics.
translation: 浏览收藏家宝箱、私人储物品和陶瓷遗物。

original: Browse one-time quest reward armor sets, faceless cloth gear, and boss drops.
translation: 浏览一次性任务奖励套装、无面布甲和首领掉落。
6. 任务专属武器与首领装备

original: Browse Sotdae of Bond, Marni's Mecha power packs, cores, and specialized mount gear.
translation: 浏览羁绊苏台、马尼机甲动力包、核心和专用坐骑装备。

original: Browse Beighen refinement tokens, shadow contracts, super skill blessings & power cores.
translation: 浏览贝根强化代币、暗影契约、技能祝福和能量核心。
恢复丢失与售出物品（回购）

original: Items you sell to merchants, discard, or delete will automatically appear here for instant recovery.
translation: 出售、丢弃或删除的物品会自动出现在这里，可立即恢复。

original: Items you sold, discarded, or deleted. Select any item to buyback and restore.
translation: 已出售、丢弃或删除的物品。选择物品即可回购并恢复。

original: Restores every single lost, sold, or deleted item listed below back into your inventory.
translation: 将下方所有丢失、售出或删除的物品恢复到背包。
>> 恢复全部丢失与售出物品 <<

original: Clears the history log without adding items.
translation: 清除历史记录，不添加物品。

original: Filter lost items by name or key...
translation: 按名称或键筛选丢失物品……

original: No lost items match your search filter.
translation: 没有匹配筛选条件的丢失物品。

original: Browse the full database of quest items, wanted notices, recipes, and rare relics.
translation: 浏览任务物品、通缉令、配方和稀有遗物的完整目录。

original: Teleport directly to the map marker / custom waypoint placed on the map.
translation: 直接传送至地图上的标记点或自定义航点。

original: Select the built-in Windows font to use if no custom font is enabled.
translation: 未启用自定义字体时选择 Windows 内置字体。

original: Use a custom .ttf/.otf font from the game folder instead of built-in fonts.
translation: 使用游戏目录中的 .ttf/.otf 字体替代内置字体。

original: Place a .ttf or .otf file in the game directory.
translation: 将 .ttf 或 .otf 文件放入游戏目录。

original: Select the custom font to load.
Increases or decreases the size of the entire mod menu.
translation: 放大或缩小整个修改器菜单。

original: Displays an enlarged icon and name when selecting items.
translation: 选择物品时显示放大的图标和名称。

original: Adjusts the preview image and panel size for item tooltips.
translation: 调整物品提示的预览图和面板大小。

original: Customize the mod menu's size and item previews.
translation: 自定义修改器菜单大小和物品预览。

original: Customize the mod menu accent and header colors.
translation: 自定义修改器菜单强调色和标题颜色。

original: Use PlayStation controller icons (Cross, Circle, etc) instead of Xbox buttons.
translation: 使用 PlayStation 手柄图标（叉、圆等）替代 Xbox 按键。
选择修改器菜单显示语言。

original: Customize the header font (requires game restart).
translation: 自定义标题字体（需要重启游戏）。

original: Shows the debug console window. (Instantly toggles)
translation: 显示调试控制台窗口（即时切换）。

original: Game version automatically detected by Trinity engine.
translation: Trinity 检测到的游戏版本

original: Crimes stop adding to your bounty or alerting faction guards (session-only, safe for save files).
translation: 犯罪行为不会增加通缉赏金或引来阵营守卫（仅限当前会话，不影响存档）。

original: Natively triggers Perfect Parry and deflect counters whenever you guard against enemy attacks.
translation: 防御敌人攻击时自动触发完美格挡与弹反还击。

original: Natively triggers Perfect Dodge slow-motion counters whenever you dodge in combat.
translation: 战斗中闪避时自动触发完美闪避慢动作与反击。

original: Preview, apply, rename, overwrite or delete this saved appearance.
translation: 预览、应用、重命名、覆盖或删除该已保存外观。

original: Saved appearance. Applying replaces every zone on this piece.
translation: 已保存外观，应用后替换该装备的全部区域。

original: Save a look before experimenting with other colors.
translation: 尝试其他颜色前先保存外观。

original: Save this appearance and restore it after trying other colors.
translation: 保存此外观，试色后可恢复。

original: Capture the equipment's actual dye data in all zones, including natural zones. Saved across restarts.
translation: 采集该装备全部区域（含自然区域）的真实染色数据，重启后保留。

original: Profiles restore all zones, materials and condition for this equipment type.
translation: 配置会恢复该装备类型的全部区域、材质与状态。

original: Inspect the saved color, material and condition for each zone.
translation: 查看各区域已保存的颜色、材质与状态。

original: Name this appearance, then choose Save Current Dye.
translation: 为此外观命名，再选择保存当前染色。

original: Delete this preset from Trinity. The equipment's current appearance stays as it is.
translation: 从 Trinity 删除此预设，装备当前外观保持不变。

original: Replace this saved appearance with the current dye on the selected equipment.
translation: 用所选装备的当前染色替换此已保存外观。

original: Restore saved colors, material and condition. Zones saved as natural are cleared.
translation: 恢复已保存的颜色、材质与状态；原为自然区域的将被清除。

original: No saved profiles for this equipment
translation: 此装备没有已保存的配置

original: Profile does not match this equipment
Could not apply profile - select the equipment again
translation: 无法应用配置，请重新选择装备

original: Could not capture dye profile - select the item again
translation: 无法采集染色配置，请重新选择物品

original: Could not create the dye profile temporary file (Windows
translation: 无法创建染色配置临时文件（Windows

original: Could not save dye profiles; previous file retained (Windows
translation: 无法保存染色配置，已保留原文件（Windows

original: Could not update %s - feature settings not saved.
translation: 无法更新 %s，功能设置未保存。

original: Could not write %s - feature settings not saved.
translation: 无法写入 %s，功能设置未保存。

original: Enter a profile name (1-63 bytes) and valid dye data
translation: 请输入配置名称(1-63 字节)与有效染色数据

original: Enter a profile name and wait for the equipment to load
translation: 请输入配置名称并等待装备加载

original: Invalid or unsupported dye profile file
translation: 染色配置文件无效或不受支持

original: Return to Dye Profiles and select the profile again.
translation: 请返回染色配置并重新选择该配置。

original: Return to the equipment list and select the piece again.
translation: 请返回装备列表并重新选择该装备。

original: Return to the equipment piece and select an unlocked socket.
translation: 请返回该装备并选择已解锁的孔位。

original: The existing profile file is retained if a save fails.
translation: 保存失败时会保留现有配置文件。

original: Wait for the current dye action to finish before saving or applying a profile.
translation: 请等待当前染色操作完成后再保存或应用配置。

original: Dye is busy or equipment changed; retry the material/condition adjustment.
translation: 染色繁忙或装备已变更，请重试材质/状态调整。

original: Dye is busy or equipment changed; select the item again.
translation: 染色繁忙或装备已变更，请重新选择物品。

original: Choose a dye color first; material and condition are ready for the next color.
translation: 请先选择染色，材质与状态将在下次染色时生效。

original: Change the selected dyed zones' material while keeping their colors. 0 = natural. Choose a color first for undyed zones.
translation: 在保留颜色的前提下调整所选染色区域的材质。0 = 自然。未染色区域请先选颜色。

original: Change wear on the selected dyed zones. 100 = pristine, 0 = battle-scarred. Colors stay unchanged.
translation: 调整所选染色区域的磨损度。100 = 崭新，0 = 严重磨损。颜色不变。

original: Dye all worn equipment pieces across all zones with the selected color.
translation: 用所选颜色为全部已穿戴装备的所有区域染色。

original: Dye the entire equipped outfit/gear set with this exact color in one click.
translation: 一键将整套已装备外观/装备染为此颜色。

original: Apply Color to All Equipped Armor
translation: 将颜色应用到全部护甲

original: Apply Color to All Mount Gear
translation: 将颜色应用到全部马具

original: Apply Current Color to All Equipped Armor
translation: 将当前颜色应用到全部护甲

original: Apply Current Color to All Mount Gear
translation: 将当前颜色应用到全部马具

original: Apply the selected color to all worn armor pieces (Helm, Chest, Gloves, Boots, Cloak) across all zones in one click.
translation: 一键将所选颜色应用到全部已穿戴护甲（头盔、胸甲、手套、靴子、披风）的所有区域。

original: Apply the selected color to all equipped horse gear pieces (Chamfron, Barding, Saddle, Stirrup, Horseshoe) across all zones in one click.
translation: 一键将所选颜色应用到全部已装备马具（马面甲、马铠、马鞍、马镫、马蹄铁）的所有区域。
染色已保存（视觉待重载）

original: Equipment edit failed - select the item again
translation: 装备编辑失败，请重新选择物品
装备同步未完成，请查看 Trinity.log
装备客户端与服务端已同步

original: Edits are queued. Wait for the synchronization result before checking the game inventory.
translation: 编辑已排队，请等待同步结果后再查看游戏背包。

original: Mount dye data updated - try re-equipping the piece if the color has not changed
translation: 坐骑染色数据已更新；若颜色未变请重新装备该部件

original: Mount dye updated - visual refresh requested
translation: 坐骑染色已更新，已请求视觉刷新

original: Your mount/horse is not currently active in the world.
translation: 您的坐骑/马匹当前不在世界中。

original: The mount is detected. Waiting for its equipped items and dye data.
translation: 已检测到坐骑，正在等待其装备与染色数据。

original: No refinable equipment found in bag
translation: 背包中未找到可强化装备

original: Refines all weapons and armor in your inventory bag to +10.
translation: 将背包中全部武器与防具强化至 +10。

original: Opens all 5 sockets on all equipment pieces in your inventory bag.
translation: 解锁背包中全部装备的 5 个孔位。
已将 %d 件背包/装备强化至 +10
已排队将 %d 件%s强化至 +10
已排队解锁 %d 件%s的孔位

original: Unlocked all sockets on %d bag/equipped items
translation: 已解锁 %d 件背包/装备的全部孔位

original: Socket data is temporarily unavailable. Refinement remains available.
translation: 孔位数据暂时不可用，仍可进行强化。

original: Log subsystem timing every 10 seconds when a call exceeds 2 ms. Off by default.
translation: 调用超过 2 毫秒时每 10 秒记录子系统耗时，默认关闭。

original: Remap w/ Ctrl+Shift: click anywhere to select new mouse button.
translation: Ctrl+Shift 重映射：点击任意处选择新鼠标键。
